name: a secret from a vendor nobody has heard of is still a secret

expect.because: The generic pass reads the variable name and the randomness, not the vendor. A provider list is never complete; this is what covers the rest.
INTERNAL_SIGNING_KEY is caught the same way — by the name and the randomness, not the vendor.

name: a Slack webhook URL is a credential

expect.because: Anyone holding the URL can post as the app. There is no separate token to steal.

name: a non-random value under a secret-shaped name is not a leak

forbid.because: Dotted module paths and header names sit high on entropy and carry nothing. Widening the name list must not widen the noise.

name: an account SID is reported, but not as the key itself

expect.because: A SID identifies the account rather than authorising it — worth saying, not worth blocking.
